I wrote the test plan for the `002-us-tags` suite (step `test-phase-00-plan`) and stopped there. No checks have run yet; the runner starts the first test phase in its next session.

- **Stories included:** US1 is `done` in both the backend and frontend loops, so it's in the plan and `not_ready` is empty.
- **`test-phase-01` (API contract):** curl calls every one of the 41 swagger operations, including the new tag operations (`addTaskTags`, `removeTaskTag`, and the `tag` filter on `listTasks`). It checks status codes and response schemas, and each call must take under 500 ms: SC-002 for the tag operations, and the app-wide limit for the rest.
- **`test-phase-02` (US1 Tag tasks and filter by tag):**
  - API checks A1–A10 cover acceptance criteria AC-US1-1..6, FR-001..008, BR-T1..T4 and the three phase-00 answers (tags are lower case, re-adding or removing a missing tag is a silent no-op).
  - UI checks U1–U8 run the same behaviour on `/tasks` through Playwright MCP, using the selectors in the UI contract.
- **`test-phase-regression`:** re-runs every phase-mode check from both layers, plus the unit tests and the 80% domain coverage threshold.

Two things are left out, both noted in the plan files and in `progress.md`:
- **No end-to-end test phase.** `US-tags.md` doesn't list an end-to-end flow, and the loop only tests the flow exactly as the requirements file gives it.
- **FR-008 "tags survive an app restart" has no check.** Sessions never stop or start the app, so it will show as uncovered in the report.

The plan files are in `loops/testing/outputs/002-us-tags/suite/`. The state is in `loops/testing/state/002-us-tags/suite.json`: all three test phases are `planned` at attempt 1, and the suite status is `running`.
